title: Pollock's octahedral-number conjecture
exact_target: Can every positive integer be written as the sum of at most seven octahedral numbers?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 9400177 (AMR-093-0177). CC BY 4.0.
